name: gaza
label: Urbicide (Gaza, Palestine)
story: The dense urban area of Gaza was subjected to severe destruction by Israel's bombing campaign beginning in late 2023. Entire neighborhoods were decimated to rubble.

name: amazon
label: Amazon Deforestation - Agriculture (Pará, Brazil)
story: The arc-of-deforestation in the eastern Amazon, primarily cleared for soy and cattle, has accelerated since 2019.

name: padre_marquez
label: Amazon Deforestation - Padre Marquez Mennonite Colony (Ucayali, Peru)
story: Approximately 365 hectares of Amazonian tropical forest were cleared in 2021 to establish a new Mennonite agricultural colony near the town of Padre Marquez in the Ucayali region of Peru.

name: dixie_fire
label: Dixie Wildfire (Northern California, USA)
story: The largest single wildfire in California history occured between Jul and Oct 2021, burning ~390,000 hectares of land. The abrupt disturbance was followed by post-fire recovery.
